home.heroTitle: Your ferry to a career in Germany
home.heroSubtitle: Karriere Fähre guides talent from Cameroon and Central Africa toward skilled jobs in Germany, and helps German companies find the workforce they're missing.
home.why1Body: Founded by a German-Cameroonian entrepreneur, Karriere Fähre understands both sides: the German labor market and Central African talent.
home.why2Body: German courses from A1 to B2, preparation for recognized exams, and support with integration.
home.why3Body: For candidates already at B2 level, direct support toward our partner companies in Germany.
home.fastTrackBody: Already at B2 level in German? Join our candidate pool and start your matching process with our partner companies.
home.fullTrainingBody: Starting out or at an intermediate level? Our complete A1 → B2 program prepares you for the exam and for integration before placement.

about.title: About Karriere Fähre
about.intro: Karriere Fähre is an international placement agency based in Douala, Cameroon, founded by a German-Cameroonian entrepreneur.
about.missionBody: Building a reliable bridge between talent from Central Africa and German companies facing a skilled-labor shortage — through training, integration preparation, and support at every step of placement.
about.founderTitle: A founder who knows both sides
about.founderBody: Having grown up between Germany and Cameroon, our founder understands both the demands of the German labor market and the aspirations of Cameroonian talent. Karriere Fähre — literally "the career ferry" — carries that bridge in its name.
about.value2: High standards in training and candidate preparation

servicesCandidates.title: Services for candidates
servicesCandidates.subtitle: Full support, from your first level test to placement in Germany.
servicesCandidates.step1Body: A German placement test to determine your path: Fast Track or Full Training.
servicesCandidates.step2Body: If needed, a complete A1 → B2 path with preparation for recognized exams.
servicesCandidates.step3Body: Join our candidate pool and get matched with our partner companies in Germany.
servicesCandidates.step4Body: Support with integration before and after departure.

servicesCompanies.title: Services for companies
servicesCompanies.subtitle: Find the skilled workforce you're missing, with end-to-end support.
servicesCompanies.step1Body: Describe the role, the number of people needed, and the required German level.
servicesCompanies.step2Body: Our team validates your company account to maintain the quality of our network.
servicesCompanies.step3Body: Browse qualified candidate profiles, ready for placement or in training.
servicesCompanies.step4Body: We support you through every step until the candidate arrives in Germany.

partners.title: Our partners
partners.subtitle: Karriere Fähre works with German companies in sectors facing labor shortages, and is continually growing this network.
partners.growingBody: Our partner network is growing steadily. Are you a German company looking for skilled workers?

germanCourses.title: Our training paths
germanCourses.subtitle: Two paths depending on your current German level.

fastTrack.title: Fast Track — Already at B2
fastTrack.body: If you already have German level B2 (certified or not), you can join our candidate pool directly for placement with our partner companies in Germany.

fullTraining.title: Full Training — Complete A1 → B2 path
fullTraining.body: An intensive path structured around the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), over about 10 months, plus 1 month of exam preparation.
fullTraining.examsBody: Goethe-Institut, TELC, ÖSD, TestDaF (B2 level). B1 exam available on request.
fullTraining.includes1: Opening and management of the student file
fullTraining.includes3: Student kit (badge, internal rules, learning materials, student guide)
fullTraining.includes4: Access to the online student area
